pts.k: *2. Vegetation: fibrin, bacterial clumps, and inflammatory infiltrate (neutrophilic or lymphohistiocytic)
pts.note: 淡紫色細顆粒團塊，判讀為細菌團，但也可能是鈣化，不確定

pts.k: 4. (In chronic lesion) organization and calcification
pts.note: 深紫色、有裂痕的團塊，判讀為鈣化

pts.k: *1. Tubular epithelial coagulative necrosis
pts.note: 腎小管上皮淡染、核消失（ghost tubules）

pts.k: *1. Coagulative necrosis with hemorrhage — mucosal and transmural (impending perforation)
pts.note: 左上黏膜只剩輪廓（凝固性壞死），整層腸壁出血

pts.k: *1. Multifocal fibrosis replacing myocytes (remote change); slightly increased mononuclear inflammatory cells
pts.note: 淡粉紅色膠原取代心肌，中間夾著殘存的心肌島

pts.k: *1. Focal liquefactive necrosis: loss of the original structure → loosening of the tissue
pts.note: 神經組織疏鬆、大量空泡（loosening）；整片都類似，邊界不明顯，也還沒找到典型的 gitter cells，請自行確認

pts.k: *1. Center: caseous necrosis — a structureless collection of lysed cells & amorphous granular debris (complete loss of cellular details)
pts.note: 無細胞輪廓的粉紅色顆粒狀壞死物，夾雜核碎屑

pts.k: *2. Periphery: granulomatous inflammation
pts.note: 壞死區周邊較紫的發炎細胞帶；類上皮組織球還沒在 40× 下確認

pts.k: *2. Basophilic calcium deposits ("saponification")
pts.note: 脂肪細胞輪廓內藍紫色顆粒沉積（皂化），周圍有發炎細胞

pts.k: *1. Shadowy outlines of necrotic fat cells
pts.note: 右上淡粉紅、只剩輪廓的壞死脂肪細胞

pts.k: *1. Nodules of cystically dilated hyperplastic glands → epithelial infoldings → papillae
pts.note: 擴張的腺體，腔內有乳突狀內摺，周圍是纖維肌肉間質

pts.k: *1. Lipid droplets in hepatocytes
pts.note: 肝細胞內大小不一的透明脂滴（大滴型會把核推到旁邊）

pts.k: *1. Dark black pigments in macrophages/histiocytes
pts.note: 組織球內大量黑色顆粒（碳粉）

pts.k: *1. Nests & cords of proliferative melanocytes (nevus cells) in the dermis
pts.note: 真皮內一團團大小一致的痣細胞，中間有膠原分隔

pts.k: *1. Yellow-brown ceroid-laden macrophages in the lamina propria
pts.note: 腺窩之間固有層內的褐色色素巨噬細胞

pts.k: *1. Golden yellow-brown, refractile hemosiderin accumulation in hepatocytes (some in macrophages)
pts.note: 肝細胞與 Kupffer 細胞內的金褐色顆粒

pts.k: *2. Ballooning change (hepatocytes)
pts.note: 左下腫大、細胞質淡而透明的肝細胞

pts.k: *1. Green-brown bile pigments in hepatocytes and dilated canaliculi
pts.note: 擴張的小膽管內有圓形褐綠色膽栓（bile plug），肝細胞內也有色素

pts.k: *1. Brown-black malaria pigments in macrophages (Kupffer cells) and hepatocytes
pts.note: 竇狀隙內 Kupffer 細胞的褐黑色細顆粒（這張染色偏紫）

pts.k: *2. Sinusoid dilation
pts.note: 同一個視野：肝細胞索之間的竇狀隙明顯變寬

pts.k: *1. Mucosal and mural neutrophil infiltration, involving muscularis propria (± lymphocytes, plasma cells, eosinophils, histiocytes)
pts.note: 固有肌層的平滑肌束之間有水腫和發炎細胞浸潤（多為嗜中性球）

pts.k: *2. Submucosal edema
pts.note: 黏膜下疏鬆、水腫的間質，夾著漿黏液腺

pts.k: *1. Submucosal mixed inflammatory cell infiltrate of lymphocytes, plasma cells, and eosinophils (histiocytes and neutrophils few in this slide)
pts.note: 呼吸道上皮下方的混合性發炎細胞；嗜酸性球在這個畫面還沒確認

pts.k: *1. Center: suture
pts.note: 一顆顆圓形、灰紫色、會反光的縫線纖維橫切面（右下有縱切）

pts.k: *2. Periphery: granulomatous inflammation
pts.note: 縫線旁的組織球和多核巨細胞

pts.k: *2. Granulation tissue: loose ECM with edema, capillary proliferation, mixed inflammatory cells (lymphocytes, plasma cells, eosinophils, histiocytes, neutrophils)
pts.note: 疏鬆水腫的間質中有許多充血的新生微血管和發炎細胞

pts.k: *1. Red pulp expansion
pts.note: 紅髓佔大部分；白髓（左下藍紫色小團）相對少而小

pts.k: *2. Red pulp congestion (& fibrosis — not obvious in this slide)
pts.note: 紅髓竇內塞滿紅血球

pts.k: *3. Dilated sinusoids
pts.note: 同一個視野：充滿紅血球的竇狀隙；擴張程度不一定明顯

pts.k: *1. Dilated and congested submucosal vessels
pts.note: 黏膜下大片擴張、充滿紅血球的血管腔（中間層狀的部分可能是血栓，不確定）

pts.k: *1. Centrilobular [zone 3] congestion (main finding in this slide)
pts.note: 竇狀隙塞滿紅血球、肝細胞索變細；左上角是保存較好的肝細胞。是否確為 zone 3 請對照中央靜脈位置

pts.k: 2. Centrilobular [zone 3] hepatocyte necrosis (only focal in this slide)
pts.note: 同一個視野：充血區內肝細胞減少／脫落，可能是局部壞死

pts.k: *2. Centrilobular [zone 3] fibrosis — key difference from nutmeg liver
pts.note: 管壁變厚、纖維化的靜脈，周圍有纖維帶往外延伸（判讀為中央靜脈，不完全確定）

pts.k: *1. Centrilobular congestion (and necrosis)
pts.note: 靜脈周圍竇狀隙內的紅血球聚集（充血）

pts.k: *1. Wedge-shaped coagulative necrosis (localized, clear border; glomeruli + tubules)
pts.note: 腎小管和腎絲球都只剩輪廓、核消失（梗塞區）；邊緣有出血帶

pts.k: *1. Papillomatosis (papillary architecture with fibrovascular cores)
pts.note: 低倍下整個病灶呈乳突狀，中間有纖維血管軸心

pts.k: *2. Koilocytosis
pts.note: 上層細胞核皺縮、周圍有透明空暈（koilocyte）；這個視野不算很典型

pts.k: *3. Molluscum bodies (Henderson-Patterson bodies) in the crater: large, eosinophilic to basophilic intracytoplasmic inclusions that push aside the nucleus
pts.note: 左上：鱗狀細胞內大型、紫紅色的包涵體（molluscum bodies）把核推到旁邊

pts.k: *1. Sulfur granules: clumped colonies of bacteria in center (basophilic) with eosinophilic periphery with club-like projections (Splendore-Hoeppli phenomenon)
pts.note: 膿腔中新月形、均質藍紫色的菌落團塊，邊緣呈嗜酸性鬚狀，周圍圍繞嗜中性球

pts.k: *2. Acute and chronic inflammation with abscess formation
pts.note: 整片密集的發炎細胞和膿瘍空腔

pts.k: *2. “Necrotizing” granulomatous inflammation — "necrotizing" preferred, since "caseating" is easily misread as tuberculosis
pts.note: 中央大片粉紅色壞死，周圍較紫的一圈是發炎反應；肉芽腫和菌絲都還沒在高倍確認

pts.k: *1. Fungal hyphae with septa and acute-angle branching
pts.note: 淡染、交織成網的菌絲團（fungal ball）；分隔和銳角分枝在這張截圖解析度下看不清，請自己放大確認

pts.k: *1. Numerous round to oval, refractile, thick-walled fungal yeasts (narrow-based budding)
pts.note: 滿滿的「肥皂泡」樣透明空洞：莢膜不著色形成空暈，中間有小小的酵母菌體，多在組織球內

pts.k: *1. Foamy, granular, eosinophilic exudate in the alveolar spaces
pts.note: 右上肺泡腔內泡沫狀、顆粒狀的粉紅色滲出物；和巨噬細胞混在一起，不是很典型的位置，請再找更明顯的區域

pts.k: *1. Cytopathic effects compatible with herpes infection (3M):
pts.note: （線上用 PA0332 看）表皮內水泡旁的角質細胞；多核、核互相擠壓、核質毛玻璃樣在這個截圖還無法確認，請自己在 40× 找
